verdict.rationale: Baseten documents Model APIs that let you call supported hosted LLMs without deploying them. These are token-billed, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible shared endpoints, and the deprecation docs mention migrating to the deprecated model weights, which implies open-weight models. However, the pack never names which model families are in the catalog or shows how broad or current it is. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog listing Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS or peers, evidence of catalog breadth and currency, and independent corroboration.
